title: Child guide and stop
implementation: Typed parent-owned child guide/stop instead of the donor's generic agent.native_action gateway: agent.subagents.guide/stop.request carry Ait identities only, Operation::ChildGuide/ChildStop are Access::Session + Target::Parent in the parent lane, and AgentSession::guide_child/stop_child (default Rejected) return a ChildControlReceipt; the typed ChildGuideOutcome/ChildStopOutcome (or ChildControlFailure) arrives asynchronously as AgentTurnEvent::ChildControl. The manager validates a live managed parent, the observed child's parentAgentId/rootAgentId chain, ready/current health, an optional observation revision fence and (guide only) a running child before any native write; the observed child stays read-only and never gets a writer. The lane parks the RPC reply under the receipt token and settles it from a later drain, so queued permissions and reads keep flowing while the native runtime answers. Only OMP implements the port (get_subagents membership re-check, then native steer_subagent/cancel_subagent in the parent's managed process); other adapters keep the port default and report UnsupportedCapability. Host feature subagentControls derives from both methods; parent snapshots advertise supportsChildGuide/supportsChildStop from adapter-verified facts.
acceptance: Wrong-parent/stale-owner requests are rejected, child identity is stable, stop/guide reach the native child once, and no second writer is created.
compatibility: Additive only. Wire: two new request/response method pairs plus an optional subagentControls host feature and optional supportsChildGuide/supportsChildStop capability flags; no existing payload gains a required field. Old clients never send the methods and keep the ADR-209 read-only observed tree. New clients on an old host see the feature absent and hide the controls; direct calls get MethodNotFound. A host whose adapter does not implement the typed port keeps the default Rejected, which the two child-control RPCs map to UnsupportedCapability in the write-free path (other operations keep the existing map_manager mapping), and no flags are advertised; validation failures (non-live parent, wrong parent chain, stale observation, revision mismatch, non-running guide target) also surface as UnsupportedCapability. Rust: Operation, port and manager entry points are new, and AgentSession gains a defaulted service_controls hook; existing method signatures are unchanged. The donor runNativeAction/agent.native_action.request gateway and its auto-resume of a non-live parent are not introduced.
